description: This file defines the TaskContext class and related classes/functions for managing task execution context in PySpark, including barrier synchronization features.

classes.name: TaskContext
classes.description: Represents contextual information about a Spark task, including attempt number, partition ID, stage ID, local properties, CPUs, and resources.

classes.name: BarrierTaskContext
classes.description: Extends TaskContext with additional methods for barrier synchronization in Spark.

classes.name: BarrierTaskInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a barrier task, specifically its executor address.

methods.name: TaskContext.get
methods.description: Returns the current active TaskContext instance, or None if not initialized.

methods.name: BarrierTaskContext.get
methods.description: Returns the current active BarrierTaskContext; raises error if not in a barrier stage.

methods.name: BarrierTaskContext._initialize
methods.description: Initializes the BarrierTaskContext with connection info and secret.

methods.name: BarrierTaskContext.barrier
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks in the stage reach this barrier.

methods.name: BarrierTaskContext.allGather
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation, returning list of messages from all tasks.

methods.name: BarrierTaskContext.getTaskInfos
methods.description: Returns list of BarrierTaskInfo objects for all tasks in the barrier stage.

methods.name: _load_from_socket
methods.description: Loads data from a socket connection, used for barrier and all-gather communication.
